observations: The 1.10 m first rod is visually dominant and the 0.38 m terminal rod remains compact through the coupled motion.
The first rod is 63.2% of the pivot-to-base stand height and the projected bracket is 31.8% of the first rod length, matching the approved apparatus image instead of the oversized revision 4 stand.
The middle and terminal bob radii are reduced to 0.06 m and 0.04 m; their radius-to-link ratios now match the approved apparatus image.
Both visible rods use a 0.022 m radius, reducing the first-rod diameter-to-length ratio from 6.4% to 4.0% while keeping the links clearly legible.
A higher-realism appearance anchor reproduces frame 0 with less than 2.4% normalized boundary error per axis.
The pendulum moves in a plane in front of the rear support; the second rod has 0.295 m depth clearance and the terminal bob has 0.290 m.
The complete stand, base, asymmetric links, and both bobs remain inside the locked frame.
